mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_member SET visible_after_seq = #{seq}, last_read_seq = GREATEST(last_read_seq, #{seq}), last_message_id = NULL, last_message_preview = NULL, last_message_sender_nickname = NULL, last_message_at = NULL, is_last_message_recall = 0, updated_at = #{now} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(c.last_seq - m.last_read_seq, 0)), 0) FROM conversation_member m JOIN conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.inbox_visible = 1
SELECT user_id FROM conversation_member WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id

SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id, m.user_id, m.last_read_seq, m.visible_after_seq, m.last_message_id, m.last_message_preview, m.last_message_sender_nickname, m.last_message_at, m.is_last_message_recall, m.mute, m.pin, m.deleted, m.banned, m.last_seen_announcement_version, m.created_at, m.updated_at, COALESCE(m.last_message_at, m.created_at) AS activity_at FROM conversation_member m JOIN conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.inbox_visible = 1
AND m.banned = 0 AND (c.banned IS NULL OR c.banned = 0 OR c.created_by = #{userId})
AND (IFNULL(m.pin, 0), COALESCE(m.last_message_at, m.created_at), m.id) < (#{cursor.pin}, #{cursor.activityAt}, #{cursor.rowId})
ORDER BY IFNULL(m.pin, 0) DESC, COALESCE(m.last_message_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_member SET last_message_id = #{messageId}, inbox_visible = 1, last_message_preview = #{preview}, last_message_sender_nickname = #{senderNickname}, last_message_at = #{messageAt}, is_last_message_recall = 0, updated_at = #{messageAt} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND deleted = 0
